title: Divisions of the Bible
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child states the Old Testament has 39 books and names Genesis and Exodus as the first two.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the two divisions of the Bible.
floor.question: Name the two divisions of the Bible.

representations: a song on the first books
steps: Find the Old Testament in a Bible.

board.do: Wait for the child to say 39.
Write Genesis, Exodus first on the shelf.

misconceptions.ask: How many books are in the Old Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Write OT 39 on a long shelf drawing.

misconceptions.ask: What are the first two books of the Old Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Open the Bible at the very front: Genesis, Exodus.

misconceptions.ask: Which book comes first, Genesis or Exodus?
misconceptions.repair: Genesis means beginning; it tells of creation, so it comes first.

misconceptions.ask: How many divisions does the Bible have?
misconceptions.repair: Show a Bible with a ribbon between the two testaments.

checks.question: How many books are in the Old Testament?
Name the first book of the Bible.
